title: Bump aws-sdk-go-v2 and Go toolchain to clear 2 Snyk high-severity issues
description:
## What

Clears the 2 open Snyk **high**-severity findings in this module.

| Snyk ID | Issue | Package | Was | Now | Fixed in |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SNYK-GOLANG-GITHUBCOMAWSAWSSDKGOV2SERVICES3-16316411` | Uncaught Exception (CVSS 8.2) | `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3` | v1.26.10 | **v1.107.1** | >=1.97.3 |
| `SNYK-GOLANG-GITHUBCOMAWSAWSSDKGOV2AWSPROTOCOLEVENTSTREAM-16316402` | Uncaught Exception (CVSS 8.2) | `aws-sdk-go-v2/aws/protocol/eventstream` | v1.4.1 | **v1.7.17** | >=1.7.8 |

`aws-sdk-go-v2` core (v1.16.4 -> v1.43.5), `config` (v1.15.9 -> v1.32.36) and
`golang-migrate/migrate/v4` (v4.15.2 -> v4.19.1) follow to keep the module graph coherent.

## Why the Go directive moves

Current `aws-sdk-go-v2` declares `go 1.24` and `migrate/v4` declares `go 1.24.0`, so the bump is not
optional. `go 1.18` -> `go 1.25.12`.

1.25.12 is the version being standardised across the academy Go repos in this remediation set: it
clears every dependency floor in play (aws-sdk 1.24, migrate 1.24, chi 1.23, pgx/v5 1.25.0) and is
the lowest release with no outstanding stdlib high-severity CVEs.

CI hardcoded `go-version: 1.18.x` — the only repo in the set not reading from `go.mod` — so it now
uses `go-version-file`. `checkout`/`setup-go` moved to current majors because `setup-go@v3` cannot
resolve a 1.25.x toolchain.

The large `go.sum` reduction is `go mod tidy` under module-graph pruning dropping database drivers
that `migrate` v4.15.2 pulled in unconditionally.

## Ordering — please merge this first

academy-api and education-bank-api inherit these same two findings *through this module*. They
cannot be fixed until this merges and a tag is cut. Planned follow-up: tag `v0.2.0`, then bump both
consumers.

## Verification

- `go build ./...` clean
- `go test ./...` passing
- `go list -m` confirms both packages are past their fix thresholds

## Deploy risk

**None.** This is a library — no Dockerfile, no image, no deploy job. CI only runs tests. It is the
one PR in this remediation set that cannot touch production.
